methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $300K total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Hedral is a seed-stage company in the Housing & Construction sector founded by Arjo Mozumder. The company has raised $300K to date. The private comp universe consists of five comparable frontier-tech construction companies: BotBuilt, Apis Cor, Unlimited Industries, Ground Control Development, and ADMARES. No public comparables exist in this emerging subsector.

The valuation analysis applies stage-progression methodology, which is the applicable triangulation approach given Hedral's early stage and limited financial history. This method uses the $300K total raised as a value proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, implying a valuation of $750K.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $638K to $862K, with a median point of $750K. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodological input rather than multiple triangulated approaches. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier to Hedral's specific market position relative to its five private peers, the absence of public market reference points, and limited visibility into unit economics or market traction metrics. Additional data on revenue, user metrics, or recent financing terms from comparable companies would materially strengthen conviction in this range.
